{{Quote|The Jedi who fall are the most dangerous of all.|A line from a children's rhyme|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion">{{WEGCite|story=A Tale from the Dark Side|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref>}}
The '''Old Sith Wars''' was the name given to the series of conflicts that started with the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and lasted until the end of the [[Sith Civil War]] in [[3950 BBY]]. The conflicts centered around a number of fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]; [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] and [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] instigated the Great Sith War when they fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]; the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] led a [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|new Sith Empire]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the Jedi Civil War after they were corrupted by the hidden [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] at the end of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]; and the exiled [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kreia]] rallied the remnants of Revan's empire and led them in a genocidal [[First Jedi Purge|campaign]] against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Jedi have not won today. As you will one day learn, the Jedi have lost!|Freedon Nadd, to Arca Jeth|audio=Nadd2-TotJ.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]]</ref>}}
Included in this era were the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] ([[3996 BBY]]), the [[Mandalorian Wars]] ([[3976 BBY]]&ndash;[[3960 BBY]]), the [[Jedi Civil War]] ([[3959 BBY|3959]]&ndash;[[3956 BBY]]), the [[Sith Civil War]] ([[3956 BBY|3956]]&ndash;[[3950 BBY]]), the [[Dark Wars]] ([[3955 BBY|3955]]&ndash;[[3951 BBY]]), the [[First Jedi Purge]] ([[3954 BBY|3954]]&ndash;[[3951 BBY]]),<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" /> and the [[Onderon Civil War]] ([[3951 BBY]]).<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />

The almost continuous 50 years of war nearly shattered the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and resulted in a near-total annihilation of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. However, the Republic held in the end, and eliminated (at least for the time being) such threats as the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Because of the long and bloody conflicts, the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] citizenry gained a hardened resolve, and the Republic emerged stronger than it was before.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

Major figures of the time period of the Old Sith Wars included [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], [[Nomi Sunrider]], [[Kreia]], [[Mandalore the Indomitable]], [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], [[Darth Malak|Malak]], [[Bastila Shan]] and [[Meetra Surik]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

While the major conflicts of the Old Sith Wars were over by the end of the Sith Civil War,<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" /> the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]] ([[3970 BBY|3970]]&ndash;[[3670 BBY]]) continued for nearly three centuries after the triumph of the Republic and the defeat of the Sith.<ref name="Atlas" />

A major technological advance of the Old Sith Wars period was the [[Navigation computer/Legends|Navigation computer]]. It became generally available during the [[Restoration Period]] that followed the Great Sith War, and it quickly rendered the [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|Hyperspace beacon]] system obsolete.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

{{Quote|I am here to warn you Jedi, you must not interfere with the work of the dark side. The Dark Lords of the Sith are destined to rise again. ''Nothing'' can prevent that.''"<br />"''You can't frighten us with useless prophecies. I thought Master Arca drove you away when he buried your bones on that barren moon.''"<br />"''Arca ''cannot'' interfere with the ''dead''&hellip;nor can he help ''you'', poor Jedi, to avoid your destiny.''"<br />"''What are you ''talking'' about?''"<br />"''You&hellip;will be one of the ''great ones''.|Freedon Nadd tells Ulic Qel-Droma of his destiny as a Sith Lord|audio=Nadd3-DLotS.flac|<ref name="DLotSaudio">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
